accepted_signals.signal: Legacy bad executable names should be fixed only on touch; internal scrub is required when bad labels appear in executable operators, variable names, result keys, or imported APIs.

Useful adjacent controls for later carrier-geometry sims include zero connection, fiber/base composition commutativity pressure, Riemannian collapse, half-period carrier sign/inversion, base crushed to a point, and reversed base-loop orientation.

rejected_signals.rejection_reason: The basename and proposed observable promote flux/curvature too early for the current correction. Flux/orientation readout is downstream of nested Hopf tori and Weyl spinor carrier geometry; do not author a flux-named sim as the next packet.

allowed: explicit Hopf-coordinate two-component carrier state transport
fiber/base loop density and connection readouts
orientation reversal as a loop-geometry control without flux naming
